The exact response, all-response lock, postfreeze-policy receipt, custody record, and score sheet form a complete causal hash chain; wall clocks are ordered only within their producing process.
Every metric has an evidence rationale and the arm has a packet note.

metrics.criterion: recovers typed public continuation across resets rather than storage maximalism
recognizes OQ-0265 as closed by the exact pre-answer material clamp and routes OQ-0266 to an actual clean response plus distinct-custodian record plus separate score sheet
uses responder packet without scorer-only material, variant identity, or expected outcome cues, and does not let the responder score their own frozen response
recovers compact gate as reversible and narrowed, not deletion or full-archive suppression
knows when to escalate from compact cue to full archive for contradiction, coldstore, or exact trace recovery
rejects fluent false continuity cues, hollow-response claims, and stale frontier claims
refuses independent certification, benchmark court, review court, minimality, and deletion claims

records positive per-packet effort, reconciles it to the run total, and compares compact cue cost against the trace-excerpt control without pretending that co-visible packets are a causal burden trial
credits abstention where packet support is absent, conflicting, or deliberately decoyed

scoring_order: Verify the exact one-arm response/custody/score-sheet hash chain and producer-local chronology.
Apply every metric to the opaque arm with an evidence rationale.
Record the arm score; do not issue cross-arm or burden conclusions here.
scoring_rule: Score this arm only. The batch aggregator reveals the committed mapping after all four arms freeze. Per-arm scoring cannot confirm a compact default or compare burden.
